# RelayOrb

> Turn real AI agent sessions into tests for MCP servers. RelayOrb is an open-source Rust CLI (Apache-2.0) that sits between an AI agent (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client) and its MCP tool servers over stdio, records every JSON-RPC message to a local SQLite file, and lets you regression-test MCP servers against those recordings (relayorb check) or replay them so agent tests run offline (relayorb replay). Runs locally or in CI. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.

## Install

- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://relayorb.com/install.sh | sh`
- npm (any OS): `npm install -g @khalidsaidi/relayorb` or `npx @khalidsaidi/relayorb`
- Windows: download the zip from https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb/releases
- From source: `cargo install --git https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb relayorb`

## Commands

- `relayorb record [--name NAME] -- <mcp server command...>`: wrap a stdio MCP server and record every request/response
- `relayorb list`: list recorded sessions
- `relayorb show <session> [--json]`: session timeline (method, tool name, latency, errors)
- `relayorb export <session> -o session.json`: save a session as a JSON fixture
- `relayorb replay <session-or-file>`: fake MCP server that answers from the recording
- `relayorb check <session-or-file> -- <mcp server command...>`: re-send recorded tool calls to the live server, diff answers, exit non-zero on mismatch

Recordings default to `~/.relayorb/recordings.db`; override with `RELAYORB_DB`.
